primary_fog_comparison: Intersection of exact record/window keys across all three methods
additional_fog_metrics: Native supported windows and causal raw-time/event overlap per method
fog_target: At least 50 percent annotated FoG samples in the completed 120-sample window
direction_target: Existing 80 percent current-direction purity and endpoint agreement
direction_primary: Known targets on valid windows; unknown predictions count as errors
direction_additional: Full four-class stream, accepted coverage and accepted-only accuracy
fusion_evaluation: Score at the corresponding source arrival grid; never weight arbitrary timer ticks as samples
timeline_selection: First TEST record by sorted keys; first 30 seconds from record start
